Name: Nyapu Style Jakk's Quinn by AhCuteArt
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Finishing this mod took me a lot longer than I thought it would. (So many portraits and updates.) I've been wanting to complete this mod for a while now since I've enjoyed the Jakk's Quinn mod so much. I really hope you all enjoy the art I retextured. [/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][Main File] CP is just a drag-and-drop into your mods folder, and you're ready to go. FOR SEASONAL, MAKE SURE TO TURN THAT ON IN JAKK QUINN'S GMCM MENU. It's turned off by default. 

[Optional File] The portrait replacement overwrites the portraits. The manual replacement is truer to the 1.2.10 version of the mod. So some of the portraits and sprites might not match. 
You should get a prompt to replace the original files if you do it right.
If you need more guidance, Nyapu has a great example on their page.  [/color]

[size=4][b]EXTRA (only for CP version)[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]I noticed that some of the seasonal portraits didn't match their respective sprites... so I decided to fix a couple of them. If you don't like those changes, feel free to use the manual replacement version. Those portraits are identical to the ones shown in the original file. For all the changes I made, feel free to check out the logs. [/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][i]BIG thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for letting me use their art as a base. 
The BIGGEST thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1249127]DolphinIsNotaFish[/url] for always helping me debug and help write some of the code. [/i][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][i]Thank you  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/161932583]jakkpays[/url] for allowing me to retexture your character[/i][/color]
[i]Thank you earthtosyd for giving me your living portrait frame edit.  [/i]

[i]Just wanted to mention [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/242947046]BETASEnjoyer11[/url]  and their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31733]Nyapu's Portraits for Quinn[/url]. They did an amazing job, and I thought their portraits came out super cute. [/i]
